sous: The Builder’s identity. To be said every morning and every evening, until the end of your training.

paragraphes.t: I am {nom}. I am a child of God in Christ.
The Lord my God is the one and true God.
I love the Lord my God with all my heart, with all my soul, with all my mind and with all my strength.
The blessing of God is on me.
I am not cursed and I cannot be.
I am of the family of God.
I love my brothers and sisters in Christ, and I know that they love me too, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts by the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
I also love all people as myself. And I have the assurance that they cannot do me any harm. The Lord is with me.
In all circumstances and situations, I remain calm, serene and confident in my God.
He is my Father
and he is in control of everything.
He makes all excellent grace abound toward me,
he provides for my needs with riches and glory,
and he works all things together for my good.
God is for me,
and I am entirely God’s.
All is well and all will always be well.
I have been crucified with Christ.
The body of sin is dead.
Now, all my faculties and members serve the righteousness of God.
I have Jesus Christ as master and lord. I remain his property in the best and in spite of the worst.
The grace of God is fresh and abundant on me.
I am strengthened by his almighty power.
I have wisdom, knowledge, understanding and intelligence, for I have the mind of Jesus Christ.
I am led by the Holy Spirit.
I will not make a mistake.
I will not miss my target.
The Holy Spirit leads me by the brightness of his light on my path.
I am clothed with the garments of salvation. I am covered with the robe of righteousness.
My God establishes me by the fragrance of his presence.
I am a wonder and a marvel,
because I am a bearer of the glory of God.
I walk in power.
I walk in authority.
I walk in dominion.
I impact my world exceptionally.
I advance as a conqueror in the mighty name of Jesus Christ.
